notes: Proposed vocabulary after the first pull. No model is tagged yet. A value becomes accepted after a review against the pull. Values can be added, renamed, or retired; a tag is never a rigid category.

domain.definition: The field a model or artefact belongs to.

values.code: Code generation, repair, and repository work.
values.vision: Image and video understanding or generation.
values.multimodal: Two or more modalities in one model.
values.evaluation: Benchmarks, leaderboards, audits, and red teams.

task.definition: The job the model performs. This is the Desert Ant pattern: name the model for its job, then tag it so it can be found across constraints.

values.word-timestamps: Align words to their position in audio.
values.topic-tagging: Suggest topics and tags for content.
values.structured-extraction: Extract typed data into a schema.
values.language-identification: Detect the language of text or audio.
values.report-generation: Generate a structured report from notes.
values.text-generation: Generate text, chat, or complete a prompt.
values.image-understanding: Read and describe images or documents.
values.ocr: Read text from images or documents.
values.audio-language: Understand and respond to audio with a language model.
values.speech-editing: Edit speech, such as replacing or correcting a segment.
values.speech-separation: Separate speakers or sources in audio.
values.real-time-interaction: Interact in real time, often full-duplex audio or video.
values.world-model: Model an environment or interaction for simulation.
values.image-segmentation: Segment objects or regions in an image.

values.browser: In a web browser, usually through WASM or WebGPU.
values.llama.cpp: Through llama.cpp or a compatible server.

language.definition: A language the model handles, or its language coverage.

values.multilingual: More than one language, without a full list.
values.low-resource: A language or set of languages with limited data.

values.on-device: Runs on consumer hardware, without a network.
values.edge: Targets phones, wearables, or embedded devices.
values.sovereign: Designed for local or national control.
values.agents: Used in an agent or tool loop.
values.non-commercial: The licence limits use to non-commercial work.

license.definition: The licence of the weights or the work.

values.other: A custom or unspecified licence. The exact terms need a manual check.

family.definition: The model family or base lineage.

status.definition: The state of the model or artefact.

values.gated: Available after a click-through or approval.
values.build: A packaged build or conversion of a base model, such as GGUF, MLX, CoreML, ONNX, or a quantized release.
values.probe: An internal evaluation probe or experimental variant, not a product release.
values.documentation: Documentation or a report, not a model.

org.definition: The organisation or author. Values are source-native and added as they appear.

values.hf-model: A Hugging Face model card or API record.
values.hf-dataset: A Hugging Face dataset card or API record.

relation.definition: How a model relates to its base model.

values.finetune: A fine-tune of a base model.
values.merge: A merge of two or more models.
values.adapter: An adapter or LoRA on a base model.
values.conversion: A runtime conversion, such as MLX, CoreML, ONNX, or OpenVINO.
values.repackaged: A repackaged or redistributed copy of a base model by a packaging organisation.
